notes: Supplied 'He' of the verbless clause resumes יְהוָה, written earlier in the verse and rendered 'Jehovah', so it joins that name under rule 25; copula 'is' goes to the predicate מַחְסִי (rule 20).
'in whom': preposition keeps 'in', suffix takes the relative 'whom' (rule 18); no fusion since two words are written (rule 22).
